entries.subject: DAMIT 5624: selected shape and spin
entries.finding: DAMIT model 5624, version 2022-10-21, pole (341°, 49°), period 14.79564 h, taken unchanged from the archive. Mirror solution 5625 recorded as an alternative.

entries.subject: Physical scale
entries.finding: 146 ± 16 km, volume-equivalent diameter DAMIT lists for this size-calibrated model. DAMIT marks the model as size-calibrated and lists an equivalent diameter of 146 ± 16 km with it; the model references describe the scaling.

entries.subject: Resolved surface imagery
entries.finding: No spacecraft or resolved ground-based image of this asteroid was found in the archives searched for this package.
entries.revisitWhen: A resolved image or a registered surface map of this asteroid is published.

entries.subject: PDS SBN catalogue values that disagree with the factsheet or are not shown
entries.finding: The display scale "73 km (size-calibrated model)" (damit-models) implies a diameter of 146 km, outside the added Small Bodies Occultations V4.0 record 324, DAMIT model 5625 diameter 131 ± 5 km (volume-equivalent; DAMIT model 5625 fitted to 15 occultations). Both are shown; the display scale is not changed.
entries.revisitWhen: A newer release of the named catalogue, or a review that replaces the shown value.

entries.subject: Elfriede whole-disc color
entries.finding: Gaia Collaboration, Galluccio et al. (2023) published the mean of 23 Gaia epoch spectra of the unresolved disc: reflectance against the Sun in 16 bands from 374 to 1034 nm, 1 at 550 nm (0.946 at 462 nm, 0.977 at 638 nm). The shape is painted in that one color (#3f3f3d in sRGB) through the shared disc-integrated-color method, scaled to the 5% geometric albedo JPL lists (± 0.5%), from NEOWISE (Masiero et al. 2014, ApJ 791, 121; PDS bundle neowise_diameters_albedos 2.0). It is one mean, not a map. Tinaut-Ruano et al. (2023), A&A 669, L14, found Gaia DR3 reflectances slightly too red at wavelengths shorter than 550 nm; the bands are used as published, without that paper's correction.
